rulesTestNames: gives vendors to dispatchers, with no phone number to read
read: get and list (query naming programId) by accounts holding the transport dispatcher duty (coordinators included) and the programme owner, while not deleted
write: server only; written from transportVendors, one document per bound programme
migrationNotes: Exactly the fields listTransportVendors returned: id, name and active. The vendor's phone number stays in transportVendors, so a read model is possible without withholding by role. The program-arrival-views copy-forward migration creates views for sources that predate the triggers and leaves views the triggers wrote alone.
